## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Implement only the owner-bound slice tested by AC-1 and AC-2, with
   admitted durable/wire compatibility and reuse of lower-layer
   codecs/stores: the retained-view→wire call ordering (Packet B B.2
   owner map — gateway owner; decomposition row 30 — R5.19 call
   ordering): retained view → existing serialization + primary bounds →
   whole-vector Account reservation → sealed provider plan → durable
   request → deadline-bounded dispatch → durable actual/unknown usage →
   charge/release → guard.
2. Retain the regression/evidence and per-target acceptance mapping
   under `docs/build/runs/R5.19.md` and its PR record; index only
   actual results.
3. Consume predecessor contracts unchanged (`retained_selection/1`,
   `SelectionInput`, `Account::reserve`/`physical_use`,
   `created_at_ms` origin — no edits). A new shared/persisted decision
   belongs in the owning ADR admission, not an implementation-local
   substitute.

## Acceptance criteria (from the contract)

- [ ] AC-1 (D/E; positive): serialize owned retained input, bound all
    admitted input/output roles/overhead, reserve whole vector, seal
    request then dispatch; durable actual/unknown usage reconciles
    through owner; same created-origin deadline across resume/approval
    and committed drain.
- [ ] AC-2 (D/E; negative): unbounded/unfunded dispatch zero; mutated
    prepared bytes, retries, absent usage, cache/model drift, expiry
    refuse or stop; logical reversal never refunds physical use; socket
    timeout is not remote cancellation.
- [ ] AC-3 (D/E; ownership/evidence): REQ-E-207/REQ-E-006/REQ-D-006
    (+ merged aliases REQ-E-005/105/106) → numbered checks + actual
    evidence in the coverage register; achieved D/E recorded separately
    from owed R/P + actual-execution E; contributor evidence owed to
    R5.6/R5.13/R5.12 (evidence dependency, not dispatch dependency) —
    no full-target claim.
- [ ] AC-4 (E/D; scoped verification): fails-without regression;
    `cargo fmt --all --check` + owning-package tests; drift/
    removability/CI-mode checks per touch; exact commands + counts;
    scratch stores.
- [ ] AC-5 (D/E; universal phase gate): green in scope; REQ ids
    stamped; owed legs as DEFERRALS rows w/ owner/trigger/control;
    ADRs for owned decisions; run/PR/BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER agree;
    operating clauses met; no deferred predicate becomes MET by close.

## Plan

(Phase 1 — see Test matrix; refined after baseline reconfirm)

1. `hh-gateway` (the retained-view→wire owner — Packet B B.2; no new
   dependency edges — gateway already owns budget/ledger/telemetry):
   new `src/prepared.rs` — `PreparedCall` pipeline over `&mut Account`
   (the whole-vector admission landed R5.12; the physical-use fold
   R5.13 — consumed unchanged), `Transport`/`CredentialPort`/
   `EndpointAllowlist` ports, and the store's own clock + seq-0
   `created_at_ms` origin.
   - `prepare(...)`: serialize the retained input member (the
     `retained_selection/1` Json — `to_canonical_string`, existing
     codec; `view_ref` = idp address) → bound vector over every
     admitted primary role/overhead (5 token primaries + `model_calls`,
     `time.wall_ms` admitted when declared; input primaries floor =
     `codec::estimate_tokens` — under-bounded/missing role =
     `Unbounded`) → `account.reserve` whole vector (`Unfunded` =
     typed pre-dispatch refusal, zero rows beyond the ledgered
     `reserved{outcome:refused}`) → seal (`plan.content_id`,
     `request_bytes = codec::serialize(&plan)`, `request_ref`) →
     created-origin deadline (`origin + tightest path `time.wall_ms`
     hard cap; `OriginMissing`/`UntrustworthyOrigin` typed).
   - `dispatch(...)`: re-derive the same deadline (never session
     arithmetic — resume/approval safe) → `PreparedBytesMutated` on any
     drift of the presented plan bytes → durable `model.call.requested`
     (first dispatch only — scope opens once) → attempt loop over
     `run_attempts` policy semantics (same prepared bytes every
     attempt; per-attempt deadline gate → `cancelled` stop, never a
     socket-timeout/cancellation conflation) → durable
     `model.call.attempt.*` joins → terminal `model.call.completed`
     (`usage{available,record}` actual / `available:false` unknown) /
     `model.call.failed` (typed class — timeout stays `timeout{…}`,
     never re-spelled cancelled) → `account.charge` per admitted
     primary dimension with `reservation_id` + terminal-event source
     (idempotent dedup landed) / `account.release` the remainder on
     expiry-drain. Retry reuses the same reservation (B.5).
2. `crates/hh-gateway/tests/r5_19.rs` — battery per the test matrix;
   `Store::open_with` + `ManualClock` for resume/approval/expiry legs;
   fake `Transport` capturing dispatched bytes (B.9 check 1 pattern).
3. Docs/records: coverage dated contributing note (AC-3); ADR for the
   owned landing decisions if any MET-DIFFERENTLY; run ledger +
   PR record.
